arithmetic_deductions: Four printed melody note names imply four target positions, without printed metric placement.
Standard tuning plus authored high-e frets 0-1-3-0 gives E4-F4-G4-E4 (MIDI 64-65-67-64).
The literal page 2 grip x-3-5-4-5-3 sounds C3-G3-B3-E4-G4; its uppermost G4 masks an intended E4 upper melody.

fathom_authored_choices.route: high-e string 0-1-3-0, one note per slot
fathom_authored_choices.release: stop each note at the next target onset; final note ends at q4
fathom_authored_choices.scope: Pass 1 melody-only diagnostic; the printed chord/melody alternation is retained as the broader study plan, but no chord body is sounded or claimed in Pass 1

structural_boundary: A sounded chord on slots 1 and 3 would contradict the page 3 label Pass 1: melody only. A four-note melody-only rendering cannot itself establish chord-melody alternation or the complete Module A study.
